**Key Sources:**
1. **PDP VIII (2023):** Vietnam’s Power Development Plan VIII (2021–2030, with vision to 2050), issued by Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT). Primary source for project status, COD, and policy direction. URL: https://moit.gov.vn/en/Pages/2023-05-15-power-development-planning-for-2021-2030.aspx
2. **EVN PDP VIII Summary:** Vietnam Electricity’s official summary of PDP VIII. URL: https://www.evn.com.vn/c3/hoat-dong-san-xuat-kinh-doanh/so-luoc-quy-hoach-dien-viii-21355.aspx
3. **IEA Coal/Gas/LNG Trackers:** International Energy Agency’s project databases. URLs: https://www.iea-coal.org/, https://www.iea.org/reports/southeast-asia-energy-outlook-2022/
4. **Global Energy Monitor (GEM):** Independent tracking of global fossil fuel infrastructure. URL: https://globalenergymonitor.org/projects/global-coal-plant-tracker/
5. **Corporate Websites:** PV Gas (https://www.pvgas.com.vn), PV Power (https://www.pvpower.vn), JERA (https://www.jera.co.jp), Son My Energy (https://sonmyenergy.com/)

**Notes on Methodology:**
- Only plants with individual units >30 MWe are included. Some older plants (e.g., Ninh Bình) are listed for context but marked as retired.
- "Operational" includes plants in commercial operation as of mid-2024.
- "Suspended" indicates projects halted with potential for revival (e.g., Thai Binh 2 was suspended but resumed).
- All coal plants listed as "Cancelled" were formally removed from PDP VIII (May 2023).
- LNG projects face significant financing and offtake challenges; COD dates are highly uncertain.
- Domestic gas plants rely on declining fields (e.g., Nam Con Son, PM3); new CCGT projects (Nhon Trach 3&4) are exceptions using remaining reserves.
- USC = Ultra-supercritical; CCGT = Combined Cycle Gas Turbine; OCGT = Open Cycle Gas Turbine.

## Goal

Produce a complete, primary-sourced reference inventory of Vietnam's past, present and future thermal generation assets (> 30MWe) structured as follows:

## Structured power plants table

Tabulate for every thermal power plant in Vietnam:

| Name (Vietnamese) | Name (English) | Province | Fuel | Technology | Units × MW | Total MWe | Status | COD | Owner/Developer | Source 1 | Source 2 | Notes |

Where:
- Fuel: Coal / Domestic gas / Imported LNG
- Technology (coal): Subcritical / Supercritical / USC
- Technology (gas): CCGT / OCGT
- Status: Approved / Planned / Operational / Under construction / Suspended / Cancelled / Retired
- Total MWe: Include units > 30MWe.
- COD: Actual or expected commercial operation date
- Sources: specify where in the document, include URL

Output format: Markdown.
